overview.title: Home
overview.content: Your projects and project creation begin here.

create.title: Create a real project
create.content: Choose New project to see the ways a piece of work can begin.

kind.title: Three ways to begin
kind.content: Start a research project, bring in a manuscript you already have, or work from a prepared template.

kindTemplate.title: Work from a template
kindTemplate.content: Choose Use a template to open the gallery. The other two starting points are there whenever you need them.

gallery.title: Find your starting point
gallery.content: Browse categories, search by name, and narrow templates by compiler or offline availability.

template.title: Choose a template
template.content: Select any real template to continue. Its files will become your new project.

name.title: Name your project
name.content: Enter a project name. Next becomes available when the name is not empty.

color.title: Choose a cover color
color.content: This color makes the project easy to spot on Home. You can keep the template default.

createProject.title: Create your project
createProject.content: Click "Create project" to create a project with the selected template.

toolbar.title: Project toolbar
toolbar.content: Project actions and compilation controls live here.

sidebar.title: Workspace navigation
sidebar.content: Move between files, search, source control, preflight, references, and MCP activity.

editor.title: Editor
editor.content: Write and navigate source with completion, diagnostics, formatting, and code intelligence.

wysiwygToggle.title: Try WYSIWYG mode
wysiwygToggle.content: Switch between raw source and a formatted, Google-Docs-style view of your document.

compile.title: Compile and recompile
compile.content: Build the current project here. The tour never compiles or changes your source.

logs.title: Build logs
logs.content: Open build logs to inspect errors without changing project content. The adjacent status shows the latest compile time.

preview.title: PDF preview
preview.content: The compiled document stays beside your source in split view.

zoom.title: Your complete PDF toolkit
zoom.content: Open the outline, search text, jump between pages, choose single or two-page layouts, zoom or fit the page, invert colors, use the accessible reader view, rotate, download, save to the project, go fullscreen, or open the preview in its own window.

sourceNavigation.title: PDF to source
sourceNavigation.content: Click compiled PDF content to jump directly to the corresponding source.

open.title: Research workspace
open.content: Open it to hand research tasks to an agent and to link reading folders and datasets you keep elsewhere. This is new and in beta, so please report anything that breaks.

tasks.title: Queue research tasks
tasks.content: Describe a piece of work and hand it to an agent. Each task keeps its own conversation, outputs, and review notes.

folders.title: Link folders you already keep
folders.content: Point the workspace at reading folders and datasets outside the project. Nothing is copied or moved.

navigation.title: Settings
navigation.content: Move between preferences and integrations here.

general.title: General preferences
general.content: Control editing behavior, offline mode, shortcuts, and tour guides.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.content: Choose the theme, typography, default workspace layout, and accent color.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.content: Review project-specific and global words ignored by spelling and grammar checks.

data.title: Data Storage
data.content: Inspect local project storage and manage application data.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.content: Configure providers, models, credentials, and the MCP servers the assistant can use.

compiler.title: Compiler
compiler.content: Choose and configure the LaTeX engine used to build projects.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.content: Manage packages and resources available for offline work.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.content: Connect GitHub, alphaXiv, Zotero, citation search, and Oleafly's local MCP server.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.content: Review, edit, set, and reset application keyboard shortcuts.

mcp.title: Assistant MCP
mcp.content: Choose which MCP servers the assistant can use.

help.title: Help and About
help.content: Restart the contextual tour, open documentation, view shortcuts, or report a problem.

tabs.title: AI Assistant settings
tabs.content: Manage providers and keys, instructions, personas, reusable skills, and MCP servers here.

providers.title: Connect providers
providers.content: Paste a key and it is validated against the provider before saving. Connected providers show a green badge and expand into a model list you can toggle, extend, or restore. Keys stay encrypted on this computer.

customProvider.title: Bring your own endpoint
customProvider.content: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL works here, including local servers like Ollama or LM Studio.

openInstructions.title: Instructions
openInstructions.content: Click the Instructions tab to continue.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.content: New chats start with this model. You can still switch models per conversation from the chat panel.

instructions.title: Custom instructions
instructions.content: Your standing style preferences, added to every request the assistant makes.

openPersonas.title: Personas
openPersonas.content: Click the Personas tab to continue.

personas.title: Create personas
personas.content: Named instruction sets with a color, switchable from the chat's Persona menu. Try a copyeditor, a reviewer, or a LaTeX purist.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.content: Work with a project-aware assistant without sending anything during this tour.

runtime.title: Two kinds of agent
runtime.content: The Oleafly agent runs on the model provider you configure. The CLI agent, in beta, drives a coding agent already installed on this computer.

connectProvider.title: Connect a provider
connectProvider.content: If no provider is configured, start here. The tour never asks for or changes credentials.

providerModel.title: Provider and model
providerModel.content: Switch models for this conversation. Changes apply to this session only. Your default model is set in Settings. Logos identify each model's provider.

prompts.title: Prompt shortcuts
prompts.content: Choose a ready-made prompt to place it in the chat input.

persona.title: Persona
persona.content: Choose how the assistant should work. An active persona replaces your default instructions until you turn it off.

input.title: Chat input
input.content: Describe what you need. The assistant can use project context, but this tour never sends a request.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.content: Attach images, PDFs, and source files when a conversation needs extra context.

history.title: Conversation history
history.content: Reopen recent and full chat history while keeping each conversation tied to its project state.

usage.title: Usage
usage.content: Configured conversations show run, token, and estimated-cost usage here when available.

restore.title: Restore project state
restore.content: After an AI edit, a checkpoint can restore project files without removing the conversation.

composer.title: Diagram Composer
composer.content: Build diagrams visually or from TikZ code. The tour does not modify or save your work.

import.title: Import a TikZ file
import.content: Already have a .tikz or .tex file? Import it to replace this starter drawing. It stays a draft until you choose to save it.

modes.title: Draw and Code
modes.content: Draw mode lets you work directly on the canvas. Code mode shows the generated TikZ and reusable snippets.

palette.title: Shape palette
palette.content: Choose a shape, then click and drag on the canvas to place and size it.

handles.title: Connect and resize
handles.content: A selected shape exposes connection and resize handles for precise structure and sizing.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.content: Select a shape or connection to adjust its style, text, routing, and stacking order.

preview.title: Compiled preview
preview.content: Compile opens a preview beside the editor with scale and background controls.

compile.title: Compile
compile.content: Compile renders an isolated preview without inserting the diagram into your document.

saveProject.title: Save as project
saveProject.content: Save a finished diagram as a reusable image project that appears on Home.

download.title: Download
download.content: Download the compiled diagram as a PNG file without saving it as a project.
